comments.body:
Comment update time. This is dropped by the following sea monsters:

Leviathan (low-medium chance)
Burning Leviathan (high chance)
Frozen Leviathan 100% chance? (presuming it's the same as Azure Cetus' relic drop rate)

With the DB being updated, the only unlisted recipe items left to be added (and they surely will be soon) are:

Sea Dragon's Circlet
Sea Dragon's Plate Armour
Sea Dragon's Greaves

I'll remove this comment when the remaining recipes are added. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
